question: Who are the highly cited coauthors of Hannah Bast?
query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?name ?affiliation (COUNT(DISTINCT ?cite) as ?cites) (?coauthor as ?dblp) (SAMPLE(?orcids) as ?orcid) WHERE { VALUES ?author { <https://dblp.org/pid/b/HannahBast> } . ?copubl dblp:authoredBy ?author . ?copubl dblp:authoredBy ?coauthor . FILTER ( ?author != ?coauthor ) . ?coauthor rdfs:label ?name . OPTIONAL { ?coauthor dblp:orcid ?orcids . } OPTIONAL { ?coauthor dblp:primaryAffiliation ?affiliation . } ?publ dblp:authoredBy ?coauthor . ?publ dblp:omid ?omid . ?cite cito:hasCitedEntity ?omid . } GROUP BY ?name ?affiliation ?coauthor ORDER BY DESC(?cites) LIMIT 10

question: Who are the authors of the paper named: Attentions is all you need?

entities.label: Ashish Vaswani et al.: Attention is All you Need. (2017)

query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?author ?author_name WHERE { VALUES ?publication { <https://dblp.org/rec/conf/nips/VaswaniSPUJGKP17> } . ?publication dblp:authoredBy ?author . ?author dblp:creatorName ?author_name . }

question: Return the 10 most cited papers of Nicholas Carlini
query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/> SELECT ?paper ?title (COUNT(?cites) AS ?citation_count) WHERE { ?paper dblp:authoredBy <https://dblp.org/pid/145/1806> . ?paper dblp:title ?title . ?paper dblp:omid ?omid . ?cite cito:hasCitedEntity ?omid . } GROUP BY ?paper ?title ORDER BY DESC(?citation_count) LIMIT 10

question: Database papers published in the Semantic Web Journal.

entities.label: Keith G. Jeffery: Database Conference Calendar / Calls For Papers. (1993)

query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?paper ?title WHERE { ?paper dblp:publishedInStream <https://dblp.org/streams/journals/ws> . ?paper dblp:bibtexType "article" . ?paper dblp:title ?title . }

question: Which papers did Ian Goodfellow publish after 2018?
query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?title ?year WHERE { VALUES ?author { <https://dblp.org/pid/43/7940> } ?publication dblp:authoredBy ?author . ?publication dblp:title ?title . ?publication dblp:yearOfPublication ?year . FILTER (?year > 2018) }

question: What are the most cited papers on federated learning?

entities.label: Tianli Gao et al.: Federated Learning Meets Network Coding: Efficient Coded Hierarchical Federated Learning. (2024)

query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/> SELECT ?title (COUNT(?cite) AS ?cites) WHERE { ?publ dblp:title ?title ; dblp:omid ?omid . ?cite cito:hasCitedEntity ?omid . } GROUP BY ?title ORDER BY DESC(?cites) LIMIT 10

question: List all coauthors of Yoshua Bengio.
query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?coauthor ?coauthor_name WHERE { VALUES ?author { <https://dblp.org/pid/56/953> } . ?publication dblp:authoredBy ?author . ?publication dblp:authoredBy ?coauthor . FILTER (?author != ?coauthor) ?coauthor dblp:creatorName ?coauthor_name . }

question: How many papers has Andrew Ng published in NeurIPS?

entities.label: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS)

query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT (COUNT(?paper) AS ?numberOfPapers) WHERE { VALUES ?author { <https://dblp.org/pid/n/AndrewYNg> } VALUES ?venue { <https://dblp.org/streams/conf/nips> } ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author . ?paper dblp:publishedInStream ?venue . }

question: Show papers that cite “Attention Is All You Need.”

entities.label: Cem Subakan et al.: Attention Is All You Need In Speech Separation. (2021)

query: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/> SELECT ?citing_paper ?citing_paper_title WHERE { VALUES ?cited_paper { <https://dblp.org/rec/conf/icassp/SubakanRCBZ21> } ?citing_paper cito:cites ?cited_paper . ?citing_paper dblp:title ?citing_paper_title . }
